---
title: "Error codes"
description: Every code an actor-kit error or refusal carries, what it means and how to fix it.
---

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mts from the website's docs. Do not edit: run `pnpm docs:gen`. -->

Every error actor-kit throws is an `ActorKitError` with a stable `code` and a `docs` URL pointing here; every refused message is a `Refusal` with the same. Match on `code`, never on message text.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| [`unknown_message`](/errors/unknown_message/) | The actor has no message of that name for the caller's role (and current state). |
| [`invalid_payload`](/errors/invalid_payload/) | The message's payload does not match its schema. |
| [`guard_failed`](/errors/guard_failed/) | The message's guard returned false for this caller in the current state. |
| [`wrong_role`](/errors/wrong_role/) | The message names the roles that may send it, and the caller's role is not one of them. |
| [`wrong_state`](/errors/wrong_state/) | The message is declared only by other states than the one the actor is in. |
| [`no_role`](/errors/no_role/) | No role predicate matched the caller. |
| [`not_initialized`](/errors/not_initialized/) | The actor has not been spawned yet. |
| [`invalid_delivery`](/errors/invalid_delivery/) | A forwarded message carried delivery metadata that does not parse. |
| [`invalid_actor_definition`](/errors/invalid_actor_definition/) | An actor definition is missing a required part or is not an actor contract. |
| [`invalid_versions`](/errors/invalid_versions/) | The `versions` chain is malformed, or a state does not match its version's schema. |
| [`no_version_path`](/errors/no_version_path/) | There is no step in `versions` from a persisted version to the current one. |
| [`invalid_retry`](/errors/invalid_retry/) | A service's or link's `retry` option is invalid. |
| [`invalid_timeout`](/errors/invalid_timeout/) | A `timeoutMs` option is not a positive number of milliseconds. |
| [`invalid_service_option`](/errors/invalid_service_option/) | A service declares an invalid option (`delivery`, `result` or a reserved name). |
| [`invalid_publish`](/errors/invalid_publish/) | The `publish` option names no queue, an undeclared event, or a reserved service. |
| [`invalid_journal_option`](/errors/invalid_journal_option/) | A `journal` option is invalid. |
| [`invalid_redact_pattern`](/errors/invalid_redact_pattern/) | A `studio.redact` pattern is empty or malformed. |
| [`invalid_determinism_option`](/errors/invalid_determinism_option/) | The `determinism` option is not one of the allowed values. |
| [`missing_initial`](/errors/missing_initial/) | An actor with `states` has no `initial` state. |
| [`initial_state_local`](/errors/initial_state_local/) | The initial state declares a local, but nothing exists yet to build it from. |
| [`async_handler`](/errors/async_handler/) | A handler returned a Promise. Handlers are synchronous reducers. |
| [`undeclared_event`](/errors/undeclared_event/) | `ctx.emit` named an event the actor does not declare. |
| [`invalid_event_payload`](/errors/invalid_event_payload/) | An emitted event's payload does not match its schema. |
| [`undeclared_timer`](/errors/undeclared_timer/) | `ctx.schedule` named a timer the actor (or its current state) does not declare. |
| [`invalid_timer_payload`](/errors/invalid_timer_payload/) | A scheduled timer's payload does not match its schema. |
| [`invalid_schedule`](/errors/invalid_schedule/) | `ctx.schedule` options are invalid. |
| [`invalid_duration`](/errors/invalid_duration/) | A duration is not a number of ms or a number with a unit. |
| [`undeclared_state`](/errors/undeclared_state/) | `goto` (or a persisted phase) names a state the actor does not declare. |
| [`invalid_local`](/errors/invalid_local/) | A state's local does not match its schema. |
| [`missing_state_input`](/errors/missing_state_input/) | A state that declares an enter `input` was entered on the way to another state (or as an `initial` child). |
| [`invalid_scope`](/errors/invalid_scope/) | `ctx.execute(..., { scope: "state" })` was called where no state can own the call. |
| [`invalid_transition`](/errors/invalid_transition/) | `enter` or `exit` returned a `goto` (or `exit` returned `stay`). |
| [`archive_missing`](/errors/archive_missing/) | An archived journal segment recorded by the actor is not in its R2 bucket. |
| [`archive_unbound`](/errors/archive_unbound/) | `journal.archive` names a binding that is not an R2 bucket in the Worker env. |
| [`invalid_archive_segment`](/errors/invalid_archive_segment/) | An archived journal segment in R2 is not NDJSON of journal rows. |
| [`invalid_phased_state`](/errors/invalid_phased_state/) | The persisted state of an actor with states is not `{ shared, phase, locals, stateTimers }`. |
| [`nondeterminism`](/errors/nondeterminism/) | A handler read the clock or randomness directly (Date.now, new Date(), Math.random, crypto.randomUUID, ...). |
| [`invalid_result`](/errors/invalid_result/) | A service's result does not match its `result` schema, or is larger than the size limit. |
| [`invalid_env`](/errors/invalid_env/) | The Worker env does not match the actor's `env` schema (a binding is missing or of the wrong kind). |
| [`queue_not_bound`](/errors/queue_not_bound/) | The Queue binding `publish.queue` names is not bound in the Worker env. |
| [`undeclared_link`](/errors/undeclared_link/) | A link name is not declared in the actor's `links`. |
| [`link_unavailable`](/errors/link_unavailable/) | A link could not be made or read: the target is unreachable or has no role/view for the linking actor. |
| [`actor_not_found`](/errors/actor_not_found/) | No Durable Object namespace was found for an actor type, or the binding is not an actor-kit Durable Object. |
| [`invalid_ref`](/errors/invalid_ref/) | `createRef` was called with the wrong arguments. |
| [`invalid_input`](/errors/invalid_input/) | The spawn input does not match the actor's `input` schema, or the actor needs input it was not given. |
| [`no_view`](/errors/no_view/) | The caller's role has no view. |
| [`invalid_token`](/errors/invalid_token/) | The JWT is not valid for this actor (wrong actor id or type, missing `sub`, or an invalid `act`). |
| [`journal_divergence`](/errors/journal_divergence/) | Replaying the journal gave a different state than was recorded. |
| [`journal_emitted_divergence`](/errors/journal_emitted_divergence/) | Replaying the journal emitted different domain events than were recorded. |
| [`journal_nondeterminism`](/errors/journal_nondeterminism/) | A handler read a fact on replay that the journal did not record. |
| [`journal_version`](/errors/journal_version/) | A journal event was written by a version with no path to the current one. |
| [`journal_invalid`](/errors/journal_invalid/) | The journal is incomplete or out of order for what was asked of it. |
| [`restore_out_of_range`](/errors/restore_out_of_range/) | `restore` was asked for a seq the journal cannot rebuild. |
| [`studio_disabled`](/errors/studio_disabled/) | Studio is not enabled for this actor. |
| [`studio_unavailable`](/errors/studio_unavailable/) | Studio is missing a secret or got invalid options. |
| [`studio_request_failed`](/errors/studio_request_failed/) | The Studio API answered with an error or something that is not Studio. |
| [`cli_usage`](/errors/cli_usage/) | The `actor-kit studio` command line is incomplete or invalid. |
| [`invalid_frame`](/errors/invalid_frame/) | A frame from the server could not be read. |
| [`missing_host`](/errors/missing_host/) | The client has no host to connect to (no window.location). |
| [`headers_in_browser`](/errors/headers_in_browser/) | `getHeaders` was used in a browser, which cannot set WebSocket upgrade headers. |
| [`missing_provider`](/errors/missing_provider/) | A React hook was used outside its actor context's `<Provider>`. |
| [`not_spawned`](/errors/not_spawned/) | The simulation has no actor with that type and id. |
| [`already_spawned`](/errors/already_spawned/) | An actor with that type and id is already spawned in the simulation. |
| [`unknown_effect`](/errors/unknown_effect/) | No pending effect matches the id, or the id matches effects of several actors. |
| [`invalid_rejection`](/errors/invalid_rejection/) | A simulated rejection does not match the service's declared errors or a built-in error. |
| [`timer_loop`](/errors/timer_loop/) | More timers fired in one `advance()` than the simulation allows (a timer that reschedules itself at once?). |
| [`connection_closed`](/errors/connection_closed/) | A simulated connection was closed twice. |
